svg.title: Stack and limits. Runs entirely on free tooling. Hosting: Vercel, a static frontend plus Python serverless functions. Model: OpenRouter with a free DeepSeek model, optional. Retrieval: Python standard library, no vector database. Server: Flask, with one function per route (ask, health, search). Quality: pytest, the evaluate script and GitHub Actions CI. Other hosts: a Dockerfile for Fly.io, Render, Hugging Face Spaces or a VPS. Limits: figures are point in time as of June 2025 and expense ratios change monthly; only four schemes are covered; a paraphrase sharing no vocabulary with the corpus will miss; there is no conversation memory. Disclaimer: informational only, not investment advice and not a substitute for a SEBI registered investment adviser. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme related documents carefully.

div.h2: Built free, with its limits written down

li.span: Static frontend in public/ plus Python serverless functions in api/
Free DeepSeek model for rephrasing. Optional.
Tokenizer, synonyms, BM25F and TF IDF. No vector database.
One app behind /api/ask, /api/health and a debug /api/search
pytest plus the retrieval quality gate on every push
For Fly.io, Render, Hugging Face Spaces or a VPS
Sources as of June 2025, no live data. Expense ratios change monthly, so some answers link the TER page instead.
Other Mirae funds get "I don't know". Other fund houses are refused.
A paraphrase with no shared vocabulary will miss. The fix is more phrasings in questions.
Each question stands alone, so "and for the midcap?" will not resolve.

div.span: Informational only. Not investment advice, not a recommendation, not a substitute for a SEBI registered investment adviser. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme related documents carefully.
